$comment: Slovak rules for Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 from the table of the Financial Administration (FS) 'Transpozícia Peppol BIS3', column 'UBL+SK'. Each rule has a test in validate.test.js. severity: error blocks sending, warning is shown. verified: false until the rules are compared line by line with the official table (see source).

typeCodes.$comment: UNCL1001 code per document kind. The tax document to a received payment uses 388 (tax invoice) as the FS questions and answers on eFaktúra show, not 386 (prepayment invoice) of packages/core/documents ublTypeCode.

rules.text: Only tax documents with an allowed UNCL1001 code go through Peppol.
The seller's electronic address is the DIČ (10 digits) with scheme 0245.
The buyer's electronic address is the DIČ with scheme 0245, or the buyer's own Peppol id.
An exemption reason is not allowed for categories S and Z; it is left out of the XML.
Categories E, AE, K, G and O need an exemption reason; the general reason of the category from legislation is used when the line has none.
A document with category AE carries the reverse charge text 'prenesenie daňovej povinnosti' in the note.
A seller using the cash accounting scheme (§ 68d) carries the text 'uplatňovanie DPH na základe prijatia platby' in the note.
The seller's legal information (entry in the Commercial or Trade Register) should be filled.
A credit or debit note refers to the invoice it corrects (number and issue date BT-26).
A document not in EUR states the VAT in EUR (BT-6 = EUR, BT-111) at the rate of the document.
A standard rated, reverse charge or intra-community supply needs the seller's IČ DPH.
Reverse charge (AE) and intra-community supply (K) need the buyer's VAT id.
Category O (not subject to VAT) cannot be combined with other categories on one document.
A document with an amount due needs the due date.
A classified supply must not be sent as an e-invoice.
The PDF attachment is optional; it is left out when larger than the provider allows.
A document has at least one line.
